payload.title: notification bell shows unread count after a new alert
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('unread-count')
Expected: "1"
Received: "0"

retries.errorHead:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('unread-count')
Expected: "1"
Received: "2"

note: An unread count stuck at 0 looks like the notification never registered — a real bug. But the two failed attempts land on two different wrong counts — 2 on the first attempt, 0 on the reported one — not a stable undercount repeating. A lost-notification bug would show the same missing-notification shape every attempt; landing on an overcount on the first attempt is inconsistent with a notification that never arrived, and instead matches a load-order race between an initial REST fetch on page load and a websocket push for new events, with the assertion catching a different relative ordering of the two sources each time.
